items.item: Why not index a Vec, slab, stable-vec: they either cannot reclaim memory or suffer from the ABA problem; slotmap keys are versioned, so a removed key stays removed even when the slot is reused; uses carefully checked unsafe internally.

items.item: Performance: each slot is a (value, version) tuple; key is valid only when versions match; version wraps after 2^31 delete/insert cycles on one slot (very unlikely, and safe); capacity 2^32 - 2 elements; per-slot memory 4 + max(sizeof(T), 4) for SlotMap, 4 + max(sizeof(T), 12) for HopSlotMap, DenseSlotMap 8 bytes per element and 8 per slot.

items.item: Choosing SlotMap / HopSlotMap / DenseSlotMap: SlotMap fastest except iteration, never shrinks storage (must remember the latest version per slot); HopSlotMap iterates only filled slots but insertion/removal about twice as slow; DenseSlotMap contiguous storage, two indirections per random access, Vec-speed iteration.

items.item: Choosing SecondaryMap / SparseSecondaryMap: SecondaryMap is a Vec of slots, may need memory as large as the primary; SparseSecondaryMap is hash-based and auto-removes outdated keys whose slot was reused.
